verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships its own AI Agent and Ask AI features, so connecting external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, all MCP evidence describes ReadMe hosting an MCP server for outside AI assistants (server role) and metrics on calls to it. Nothing documents ReadMe acting as an MCP client that can add third-party MCP servers and use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
